title: solidago rugosa var. celtidifolia
intro: Solidago rugosa var. celtidifolia, commonly known as Rough-leaved Goldenrod, is a type of flowering plant in the aster family, native to China and Korea. This plant is known for its traditional use in herbal medicine, where it has been employed to treat various health issues. The health benefits of Solidago rugosa var. celtidifolia include its anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which can help alleviate symptoms of fever, cough, and cold. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its therapeutic actions, including antimicrobial, antiviral, and anti-inflammatory effects.
